note: Cases the differential sweep found and a reducer shrank, kept because a generated population is rebuilt from a seed and would not find them again once the seed moved on. What each one guards is an invariant no semantic corpus checks — a certified bound, a limit edge, a preallocated context, the two matchers agreeing, the analyzer and the checker agreeing — so they are replayed through the whole sweep battery rather than compared to an expected answer. Their answers live in the regressions section of conformance/sweep.json, which every implementation replays.
